name: Eaton Zveare
biography: Eaton is a senior security research engineer at Traceable by Harness. As a member of the ASPEN Labs team, he has contributed to the security of some of the world's largest organizations by finding and responsibly disclosing many critical vulnerabilities. He is best known for his high-profile security disclosures in the automotive space: 1 , 2 , 3 .
